name: rhino-gamepad-agent-link
description: Route Rhino Gamepad voice drafts to an explicitly bound VS Code terminal with idempotent delivery.

commands.title: Rhino Gamepad: Review / Edit Voice Draft

rhinoGamepad.autoSend.description: Automatically send completed dictations to the designated terminal. No A confirmation. Does not independently press Enter.

rhinoGamepad.autoSubmit.description: DANGER: Append Enter to voice prompts. Only enable if you understand that a CLI agent may have exited to a normal shell.

rhinoGamepad.draftTTLSeconds.description: Expire unsubmitted voice drafts after this many seconds.
